Correctness, generated-code safety, deterministic behavior, compatibility, explicit constraints/failures, clear naming, stable output, strict `processor`/`workload` boundaries. Use project-local `.agents/skills` specialists: `ksp-module-router`, `ksp-logger-generator-maintainer`, `workload-regression-maintainer`, `release-compatibility-maintainer`, `reference-quality-maintainer`. Additional `AGENTS.md`: `processor/AGENTS.md`, `workload/AGENTS.md`.

Always use the Gradle wrapper: `./gradlew ...`.
full build: `./gradlew clean build`
all tests: `./gradlew test`
processor tests: `./gradlew :processor:test`
workload tests: `./gradlew :workload:test`

Keep KSP processing logic in `processor`; do not move processor behavior into `workload`.
Keep `workload` focused
